init_UNetSpatioTemporalConditionControlN: initialize a UNetSpatioTemporalConditionControlNetModel with custom block channels and attention heads for video generation
forward_UNetSpatioTemporalConditionContr: run forward pass on noisy video frames through the spatio-temporal UNet ControlNet model with timestep and encoder states
configure_down_blocks: configure the down block types for the spatio-temporal UNet ControlNet model using CrossAttnDownBlockSpatioTemporal blocks
configure_up_blocks: configure the up block types for the spatio-temporal UNet ControlNet model using CrossAttnUpBlockSpatioTemporal blocks
enable_gradient_checkpointing: enable gradient checkpointing on the UNetSpatioTemporalConditionControlNetModel to reduce memory usage during training
